AI in Agriculture — Book 1

The Precision Vineyard

The Precision Vineyard: A Grower's Field Guide to AI, Sensors and Robotics — what to adopt, what to skip, and what it pays back in viticulture.

The first book in the AI in Agriculture series. A practical guide for growers weighing up precision viticulture: which tools are ready for the vineyard, which are still a demo, and how to judge the payback before you commit.
